summary: The codebase replicates the core contributions of the paper 'Interpreting Emergent Planning in Model-Free RL', focusing on probing concept representations, visualizing agent plans, and applying interventions to test behavioral dependencies. Three main modules are implemented: (1) probing_concepts.py for training linear probes to decode square-level concepts C_A and C_B; (2) visualize_plans.py for visualizing decoded concept representations over Sokoban grids; and (3) intervene_plans.py for manipulating agent states to steer actions. Additional configurations and documentation are organized for experimental reproduction.
